data.one_liner: Convert numbers to Persian/English letters, format Jalali dates, and validate Iranian IDs.
data.what_it_does: Provides extension methods for strings and dates to convert numbers to Persian or English words, format and separate digits, convert Gregorian dates to Jalali/Shamsi dates, and validate Iranian national codes, mobile numbers, postal codes, and bank cards.
use_when: You need to display Persian (Jalali) dates and relative time in your Flutter app
You need to format numbers into words or currency (Toman/Rial) for Persian users
You need to validate Iranian national codes, postal codes, mobile numbers, or bank cards
avoid_when: Your application does not target Persian-speaking users or require Jalali date conversion
You need internationalization for non-Persian locales
strengths: Rich set of string extension methods specifically tailored for Persian and Iranian formats
Supports Jalali date conversion and relative time formatting
Includes various validators for Iranian specific data like national codes and IBANs
weaknesses: Strictly focused on Persian language and Iranian localized formats
Limited documentation outside of the README
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
